plan.title: 6-Week Beginner Fat Loss Home Gym Workout

exercises.name: Warm-up (dynamic stretches, jumping jacks)
exercises.notes: Prepare your body for exercise with light cardio and dynamic movements.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Start with 10-15 lb for females, 15-25 lb for males. Focus on deep squatting while keeping your chest up and core engaged.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Start with 5-10 lb dumbbells per hand for females, 10-20 lb for males. Lie on your back, press dumbbells straight up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.notes: Start with 5-10 lb dumbbell for females, 10-15 lb for males. Hinge at hips, keep back flat, pull elbow towards ceiling.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
exercises.notes: Use a light to medium resistance band. Pull the band apart across your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Maintain a straight line from head to heels, engage your core and glutes.

exercises.name: Cool-down (static stretches)
exercises.notes: Gentle stretches for major muscle groups, holding each stretch for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Warm-up (dynamic stretches, high knees)
exercises.notes: Prepare your body for exercise with light cardio and dynamic movements.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Start with bodyweight or 5-10 lb per hand for females, 10-15 lb for males. Step back, lower until both knees are bent at 90 degrees.

exercises.name: Push-up (Kneeling or Incline)
exercises.notes: If standard push-ups are too challenging, start on your knees or with hands on an elevated surface. Focus on controlled movement.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.notes: Start with 5-8 lb dumbbells for females, 10-15 lb for males. Keep elbows tucked in and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Tricep Extension (single dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Start with 8-12 lb dumbbell for females, 15-20 lb for males. Keep elbows close to your head, extend arm fully.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.notes: Start with bodyweight or hold a 5-10 lb dumbbell. Rotate your torso, touching the weight or hands to the floor beside you.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.notes: Aim to slightly increase reps or ensure strict form. Lie on your back, bring opposite elbow to knee, rotating through the core. Keep the movement controlled.

exercises.name: Cool-down (static stretches)
exercises.notes: Gentle stretches for major muscle groups, holding each stretch for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Warm-up (dynamic stretches, 2-3 min jump rope)
exercises.notes: Add 2-3 minutes of jump rope to your warm-up to increase heart rate and prepare for activity.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
exercises.notes: Aim to slightly increase reps or weight by 2.5-5 lb from previous weeks (e.g., 20-30 lb females, 30-45 lb males). Adopt a wide stance with toes pointed out, focusing on glutes and inner thighs.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Push-up (hands on dumbbells or feet elevated)
exercises.notes: Aim to slightly increase reps. If stable, perform push-ups with hands on dumbbells for a deeper stretch. For more challenge, elevate your feet.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Aim to slightly increase reps or weight by 2.5-5 lb (e.g., 12-18 lb females, 18-25 lb males). Brace yourself on a bench or sturdy surface for stability.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.notes: Use light dumbbells (3-5 lb per hand females, 5-8 lb males). Raise dumbbells straight in front of you to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.notes: Perform this as a conditioning exercise. Aim to maintain effort or slightly increase speed. Keep your core tight and drive knees to chest rapidly.

exercises.name: Cool-down (static stretches)
exercises.notes: Gentle stretches for major muscle groups, holding each stretch for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: Warm-up (dynamic stretches, 2-3 min jump rope)
exercises.notes: Add 2-3 minutes of jump rope to your warm-up to increase heart rate and prepare for activity.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.notes: Aim to slightly increase reps or weight by 2.5-5 lb (e.g., 10-20 lb per hand females, 20-30 lb per hand males). Keep a slight bend in knees, hinge at hips, feeling the stretch in hamstrings.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Thruster
exercises.notes: Use light dumbbells (5-10 lb per hand females, 10-15 lb per hand males). Combine a deep squat with an overhead press in one fluid movement. Aim for fluid motion.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Bicep Curl
exercises.notes: Use a resistance band that provides good tension throughout the movement. Focus on a high rep count for muscle endurance. Aim to increase tension or reps.
